transcription: Main news-release text only (site header, breadcrumb, the archival 'Notice: Historical Content' banner above the release, sidebar, share widgets and footer removed). The release-ID line 'IR-2025-103, Oct. 9, 2025' kept as printed. The standard-deduction comparison table (3 columns x 2 data rows) is transcribed as pipe-separated lines, one per table row. Bullet items keep • markers. Inline links flattened to their text ('Revenue Procedure 2025-32 PDF'). Em dashes kept as printed. Whitespace normalised.
purpose: library: IRS tax year 2026 inflation adjustments — standard deduction ($32,200 joint / $16,100 single / $24,150 head of household, with the TY2025-vs-TY2026 table), the full marginal-rate schedule with income thresholds (37% over $640,600 down to 10% at $12,400 or less), AMT exemption ($90,100 phasing out at $500,000), estate-tax basic exclusion ($15,000,000, up from $13,990,000), EITC maximum ($8,231), and items frozen by statute (personal exemptions at 0). Fits quiz cards with predict-then-reveal on the dollar amounts, a compare table of tax years, and percent-increase arithmetic on the adjustments.
